source: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Brings Up Multi-Rack NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 (09-16-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave announced the bring-up of multi-rack NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 on CoreWeave Cloud, putting hundreds of NVIDIA Rubin GPUs into a single scale-out cluster for agentic AI training and inference (following its earlier single-rack Vera Rubin NVL72 validation). Per the release, each Vera Rubin NVL72 rack pairs 72 Rubin GPUs with 36 Vera CPUs, NVLink 6, ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and BlueField-4 DPUs; racks are unified with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet, with two ConnectX-9 SuperNICs per Rubin GPU providing 1.6 Tb/s of scale-out connectivity per GPU and a non-blocking fabric supporting roughly 128,000 GPUs per rail. Only racks that clear full-rack workload validation move into production.
quarterly_data.figure: hundreds of Rubin GPUs in one scale-out cluster; 72 Rubin GPUs + 36 Vera CPUs per rack; 1.6 Tb/s per GPU; roughly 128,000 GPUs per rail
